description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations by tag on different multilingual BERT models, including mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2. The x-axis represents the tags: case, gender, number, and tense. The y-axis measures the effect, with values ranging from -5 to 20. The bars are color-coded to distinguish between the models. The mBERT-L2 model shows the highest effect for the case tag, with a value around 15, while the XLM-B2 model shows the lowest effect for the same tag, with a value close to 0. The error bars indicate the standard deviation, showing variability in the effect across different instances.
